description:
Château de mon Père is a renovated castle dating to the 13th century, set in a large garden in the countryside near Provins, still undergoing loving restoration by its owners.

Today its family rooms, with private bathrooms including bathtubs, some featuring exposed beams and antique furniture, are all within the castle building, heated and offered with 1 double bed or 2 single beds.

The castle's 13th-century origins give it a genuinely medieval foundation, though its ongoing restoration by the current owners means parts of the estate remain a work in progress rather than a fully polished finish.

The property's family-friendly room configurations, with flexible bed arrangements, distinguish it from the more couple-oriented luxury suites found at many other French château-hotels.

The castle's ongoing, owner-led restoration gives it a lived-in, low-key character rather than a fully commercial luxury finish, appealing to guests seeking an authentic, unpolished experience.

The château's position 20 minutes from Provins, a UNESCO World Heritage medieval town, gives guests staying at mon Père easy access to one of the region's most significant historic sites.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In Villiers-aux-Corneilles, Marne — about 20 minutes from Provins.

**Rooms & rates:** Family-friendly rooms from about €66 per night, all within the 13th-century castle.

**On-site:** Large garden, terrace, free bicycles, shared kitchen, paid shuttle service.

**Good to know:** A working restoration project — the owners are still lovingly restoring parts of the estate, giving it a lived-in, low-key character rather than a polished luxury finish.

**Combine with:** Provins, a UNESCO-listed medieval town, 20 minutes away.
